channel.title: DevMania Journal
channel.description: Practical guides to websites, apps and AI workflows.

item.title: How to Write a Website Development Brief
item.description: Define your audience, pages, content, integrations and launch criteria before asking a developer for a website quotation.

item.title: Website or Web Application: What Does Your Business Need?
item.description: Choose between a content website and a web application by examining user accounts, workflows, data and operating responsibilities.

item.title: A Practical Responsive Website Checklist
item.description: Test the journeys that matter on narrow screens, keyboards and real devices before launching a business website.

item.title: How to Improve Website Loading Speed Without a Redesign
item.description: Find slow images, unnecessary scripts and delayed interactions with a focused performance review of your most important pages.

item.title: Technical SEO Checks Before Launching a Website
item.description: Review crawlable pages, titles, canonical URLs, internal links and sitemap coverage before introducing your website to search engines.

item.title: How to Define the First Version of Your Mobile App
item.description: Turn an app idea into one complete user journey, a realistic MVP scope and clear acceptance criteria.

item.title: PWA or Native App: A Business Decision Guide
item.description: Compare a browser-based app with an installed mobile app using device needs, distribution, offline behaviour and maintenance.

item.title: Designing an App That Handles Poor Internet Connections
item.description: Plan saved drafts, sync states, conflicts and duplicate prevention so users can recover when a mobile connection disappears.

item.title: A Mobile App Launch Checklist for Small Teams
item.description: Prepare onboarding, permissions, support, monitoring and a staged release before making an app available to customers.

item.title: What Is API Integration? A Guide for Business Owners
item.description: Understand how connected systems exchange data and what to clarify before linking bookings, payments, CRM or shipment tracking.

item.title: How to Keep API Keys Out of Your Website Frontend
item.description: Understand where API secrets belong and how a server endpoint can protect credentials while controlling public requests.

item.title: Webhooks vs Polling: Choosing How Systems Receive Updates
item.description: Compare event notifications and scheduled checks for shipment, booking and payment integrations, including recovery and duplicate handling.

item.title: Building API Integrations That Recover From Failures
item.description: Design timeouts, retries, idempotency and useful error messages so an interrupted request does not become a lost or duplicated transaction.

item.title: Using ChatGPT to Turn a Website Idea Into a Clear Brief
item.description: Use a structured conversation to clarify audience, scope and unanswered questions before turning an idea into a development project.

item.title: ChatGPT and an OpenAI API Integration: What Is the Difference?
item.description: Understand the difference between using an AI assistant yourself and building an AI feature into your own website.

item.title: Writing Better ChatGPT Prompts for Everyday Business Tasks
item.description: Give an AI assistant context, boundaries and a clear output format for useful drafts, summaries and planning work.

item.title: How to Review AI-Generated Code Before Publishing It
item.description: Check requirements, permissions, secrets, dependencies and failure cases before accepting code suggested by ChatGPT or another coding assistant.

item.title: Using Claude to Organize Project Requirements
item.description: Turn scattered notes into a requirement register while keeping assumptions, contradictions and decisions visible.

item.title: A Practical Claude Workflow for Reviewing Business Documents
item.description: Review long business documents with targeted questions, source references and a human verification step.

item.title: How to Use Claude for Development Planning Without Losing Control
item.description: Break a development task into assumptions, small changes and verification steps before allowing an AI assistant to alter a project.

item.title: How to Evaluate Claude for a Business Workflow
item.description: Compare AI output against a repeatable test set before choosing a model or adopting an automated process.

item.title: How to Choose Your First AI Business Use Case
item.description: Select a small, measurable AI pilot by balancing repetition, available data, review effort and the consequences of mistakes.

item.title: Automation or an AI Agent: Which Does Your Workflow Need?
item.description: Distinguish predictable business rules from tasks requiring interpretation before giving software access to tools and actions.

item.title: What Is RAG? Planning an AI Assistant for Business Knowledge
item.description: Understand retrieval-augmented generation and the data, permission and evaluation work behind a useful internal knowledge assistant.

item.title: How to Plan the Operating Costs of an AI Feature
item.description: Build a cost model covering requests, input size, output, retries, hosting and human review without relying on a fixed model price.
